proposals.name: Battle Poets
proposals.entry:
The Battle Poets are among the most culturally important specialists in Gravosk society. They are historians who go where history happens.

Battle Poets accompany armies, ships, diplomatic missions and great legal proceedings. They memorize events and preserve them through structured oral recitation: courage, cowardice, promises, betrayals, who fled, who returned, who rescued an enemy, who obeyed an impossible order, and who gave that order.

A Gravosk commander may fear the Battle Poet surviving a defeat more than the defeat itself.

Oathbinding

Most accomplished Gravosk Oathbinders are Battle Poets. Their magic is based upon witnessed declarations. The speaker declares what they will accomplish and names the consequence should they fail. The presence of witnesses strengthens the oath. Older and more precisely remembered forms can become extremely powerful.

A captain might declare: “This ship reaches the eastern shore before sunrise, or my voice belongs to winter.” A Battle Poet witnesses the oath. Reality does the rest.

In war, Oathbinding may hold a collapsing bridge long enough for the final soldiers to cross, keep an exhausted crew rowing through one impossible night, or allow a dying warrior to remain standing until companions escape.

The price is stated beforehand. The Gravosk distrust magic whose cost is concealed.

posts.name: Gamemaster Only
posts.entry:
One of the most famous Battle Poets of the early 99 War knowingly falsified a heroic account. Modern titles, marriages, debts and military honors now depend upon the lie.

Another eyewitness has survived.
